claim_evidence_binding.claim_record: Each strict claims[] entry carries scope as a nonempty string, proposition_sha256 over canonical text, claim_contract_schema_version 1.1, and claim_contract_sha256 over the complete claim plus certificate assurance, including the full downstream-policy object and local claim inventory.
claim_evidence_binding.modal_wrapper_binding_requirement: At least one of test_id or applies_to_tests must canonically bind the evaluated modal test; every present optional identity field is still independently type-checked.
claim_evidence_binding.modal_world_contract: Every modal test carries closed world_contract 1.1 fields semantic_equivalence_class, operator, target, precondition, state_delta, oracle, and expected_outcome. Authorization uses the closed typed operator/target/outcome fields; prose is digest-bound explanation, not a polarity oracle. Coverage independently uses reviewer class and typed operator/target/expected_outcome identity. outcome and observed_outcome are separately hashed and must agree when both are present.
claim_evidence_binding.package_self_registry: The checked-in package certificate must contain the immutable reviewed 80-transition modal ID multiset exactly once certificate-wide, with no deletion, duplication, extra ID, or claim/kind reassignment; every complete canonical transition payload must match its pin.
claim_evidence_binding.observation_ledger: observation_schema_version 1.2 closed release-declaration records with exact claim/test/kind, proposition digest, claim-contract digest, modal digest, pass result, accepted outcome, and wrapper-equal observed_result; deduplication identity only, not execution provenance

derived_or_downstream_claims.derived_claim: A downstream deployment, safety, compliance, or action-authorizing conclusion inferred from C-001.

evidence_contract.canonical_file_policy: bundle-local canonical relative regular non-symlink files with exact bytes and sha256

formal_result_contract.companion_manifest: exact report, gate, certificate, ledger, transcript, prompt, and target_snapshot path/sha256/bytes records
formal_result_contract.output_capability_policy: formal output and compatibility JSON parents are acquired component-wise with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW before execution and held through descriptor-relative O_EXCL creation, link/rename installation, and directory fsync; canonical-result versus compatibility-JSON classification is frozen during pre-execution collision analysis against held identities and is not recomputed after writes; formal children receive only runner-owned /proc/<runner-pid>/fd/N via pass_fds, where procfs-visible Pid must equal the child's procfs-visible direct-parent PPid and child-FD close/rebind, self/unrelated PIDs, noncanonical or nonpositive PID/FD tokens, extra components, closed descriptors, and file descriptors are rejected; unavailable procfd inheritance is INVALID_INPUT before output mutation
formal_result_contract.output_check_policy: exact nonempty all-passing projection recomputed from the bound report, certificate, ledger, and gate; arbitrary self-attested checks and coherently rehashed empty report or gate companions fail closed
formal_result_contract.result_message_policy: exactly one final canonical successful SDK ResultMessage after all lane results; canonical nonempty result; empty permission_denials; api_error_status, deferred_tool_use, and non-structured structured_output null or absent; non-null terminal_reason/stop_reason exact completed/end_turn; aliases and nested contradictions fail closed
formal_result_contract.selection: typed formal.result locator only; no basename or glob-first substitution; unrelated nonreserved files may remain
formal_result_contract.standalone_target_snapshot: endpoint-checked permission-hardened copy; not temporally immutable

pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.official_validator_policy: Allowlisted validators run fresh. Claude uses exact ordered strict argv and accepts its real ANSI-normalized Validation passed form only when no failure or contradiction appears anywhere in either complete stream. Full captured bytes determine status/hash/byte counts; bounded excerpts and truncation flags never authorize. Text captures never authorize; absent tools scope only through the explicit flag while both official-policy nodes and canonical dependencies remain mandatory; installed failures fail.
pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.promotion_claim_policy: claims is a nonempty array of exact-typed objects with unique canonical ids, nonempty scope, claim-contract schema 1.1 fields, and complete modal world contracts; every claim is evaluated through the canonical strict gate at the bundle evidence root; modeled completion requires a nonempty all-PASS result set passed into promotion-v2 downstream non-closure evaluation; empty downstream conclusions remain valid only with a real passing promotion claim, performed review, and substantive reason
pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.promotion_required_top_level_types: promotion_schema_version/origin/upgrade_from_status/requested_status/package_version/package_tree_sha256 are exact strings; method_m_upgrade/live_result_bindings/evidence/downstream_review are objects; claims is a nonempty array and derived_or_downstream_claims is an array
required_evidence: fresh deterministic checks with deterministic-capture-v2 projections
formal result 2.0 with standalone endpoint-checked target copy, explicit temporal/containment limitations, PASS-SCOPED cap, and trace auth
strict gate PASS-TRACKED on generated certificate
pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.safe_output_policy: gate Markdown, certifier JSON/Markdown, formal output and compatibility JSON, live transcripts and optional JSON, validator Markdown, and the gate/formal/regression/promotion contract JSON wrappers plus the fixed behavior and stable-release manifests acquire component-wise O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW parent capabilities before their long-running work and retain them through descriptor-relative exclusive temporary or new-file creation, link/rename installation as applicable, and directory fsync; role and alias classifications are frozen from lexical names plus held identities, each output enforces its declared fresh-versus-replaceable final-name policy, and direct or ancestor links, special/hardlink sentinels, cross-output aliases, and lexical-parent substitution cannot redirect writes and fail closed; validator Markdown also rechecks that its held parent remains outside the package tree; endpoint and held-capability checks are not temporal isolation
pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.package_snapshot_policy: Package validation authorizes from one immutable initial bounded no-follow captured-byte snapshot. Authorization reads and self-test fixture trees consume or materialize only captured bytes; finalization independently revalidates the held source and private mirror. Package path/metadata and aggregate byte budgets are independent, and Git discovery/index capture has separate timeout, combined-output, and entry ceilings.
pass_tracked_upgrade_audit.stream_binding_policy: Official validator decisions and formal transcript authentication/hash/byte counts bind complete captured bytes. Public results may contain bounded sanitized excerpts and explicit truncation metadata; capture-limit excess fails closed and tail-only authentication is forbidden.
